# nix family — name/version/hash derive from the nix/store/<hash>-<name>-<version>
# directory names; distro qualifier (tapir) comes from etc/os-release
# VERSION_CODENAME.
purl pkg:nix/hello@2.12.1?distro=tapir
cpe  cpe:2.3:a:hello:hello:2.12.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
purl pkg:nix/zlib@1.3?distro=tapir
cpe  cpe:2.3:a:zlib:zlib:1.3:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
